item.text: I’m checking the reconstructed filing text for the income statement and the latest fiscal year figure, then I’ll return just the value the document supports.
`rg` isn’t available here, so I’m switching to a direct parse of the JSON and searching the extracted text for the income statement line.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json,re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/APPLE_2017_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data['texts'] if isinstance(data,dict) and 'texts' in data else data
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    s=t.get('text','') if isinstance(t,dict) else str(t)
    if re.search(r'net income|Net income|income \\(loss\\)|fiscal year', s):
        print(i, t.get('page_no'), s[:300].replace('\\n',' '))
PY"
